Hey, why don't we stop it already?\nIt doesn't break after all this. It's not a normal\nice. There's no way we can break it, right?
Shut up! I hate the cold!!\nI really wanna get outta here, right now!\nWe have no time for chatting! Use your hands!!
It's Libera and Virgo of Support Caravan for\nAdventurers inside the ice cage.
Whoa?! You're... It's been a while!
Maybe you were lost here?\n...Huh? Isn't it another world here, you say?\nOh, you are totally lost.
It's really remote from Sofya and the building\nlooks strange but it's not another world here.\nIt's Resistle fortress called Solfini.
We didn't know such a place before we were\nbrought to here...
Seems like Navida's Relics collided against\nanother part of the current world and made\na new wormhole...
Few people try to climb this mountain cuz it's\ntoo steep. It's really surprising that you could\nreach here.
...Huh? What are you doing, you ask?\nWe're not here by choice.\nTenert brought us to here for training and...
A... Achooo!!
Yikes! That's nasty!!\nStay away from me! I'll handle the rest!\n*shoo shoo*
So, we came here for training and found a weird\nguy. He was saying something strange like he's\ngot no energy because there is no Xmas...
He was getting attacked by an unknown, horrible\nknight and his soldiers, so we helped out the\nguy from them but...
As you can see, we were confined in this ice cage\nthat they generated. And it's really hard...
Oh, it's no use hitting the cage.\nWe tried it for quite a while but we couldn't\neven crack it. Well, it should melt with heat.
Oh, you're so slow to understand! You need fire\nand fuel for heat!! Get as much Small Tinder and\nWoodchips as you can!!
Sorry.\nBut it looks like there's no other option...\nCould you do that for us?
Oh, thank you! ...Sorry for the late, you say?\nThat was much faster than expected. Hey, Virgo!\nWake up! The adventurer came back!
Whoa?! You're back already? Incredible!\nThen, pass me what you've got...\nWow! Here they are. You're great, adventurer.
Alright! Libera, we've gotta melt this cage.\nSpread the wood chips on the cage...
Okay, that should do it.\nNow I'll set fire to them...\nStep back!
Woooohoooo!! The evil knight! Did you see that?!\nHa ha, now we are out of the cage!\nIt serves you right!
Man, we owe it to the adventurer, right?
Thank you so much.\nWe might have been frozen to death if you didn't\ncollect the wood chips and small tinders.
Where's Tenert the leader...?\nWasn't he with them?
Huh? Tenert? Isn't he near here?\nI thought he would be confined in another place...
Wait. When we were trapped in the ice cage,\nTenert was... Oh, right! He said something\nout of the cage and chased after the monsters!!
Seriously?!
How could I forget it just because I was upset...\nWe've gotta go help him right now...
He might be in a great trouble...
Damn! What's got into me?!\nI was just staying in the cage but...
Seems like they are unexpectedly exhausted\nbecause of cold...
...A wormhole to another world over there?\nThe strange guy escaped through it? That's great\nbut we can't leave Tenert here...
...You can go find Tenert?!\nBut it'll be faster if we...
Libera, don't push yourself too much.\nYou can't even walk, can you? Let's leave it to\nthe adventurer now and prepare to come back.
...You're right. Thanks adventurer. But you\nshould watch out for the knight and his soldiers.\nThey are all strong. Please, find Tenert.
Ouch! Ouuuucchhhh!!
Agghhh! Ouch! Oooouchhh!!\nDamn you! You think I'm a turkey or something?!\nOuch! You hear me?! I'm saying OUCH!
Ha ha ha ha! Yea. It should be ouch.\nRegret for defying Inzanio in fire!!
Who are you?\nYou fight us knowing we're Inzanio's servants?!\nShame on you! Bring it on!!
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Pawn!!
I thought I was going to be roasted and eaten.\nAnyway, why are you... Well, it doesn't matter.\nThanks for saving my... Ouch!!
Tenert got burned and frostbite.\nHe can barely walk, so you should take him to\nNavida's Relics now...
So, Libera and Virgo asked you to help me...\nI'd really like to go beat their leader but...\nI can't fight now...
I'll do as you said...\nI'm alright. I can walk myself...
It's you again!! You got a help this time, huh?!\nDon't think you can't beat me like the last time!\nI'll send you two straight to hell!!
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Pawn!!
Ugh... I-Inzanio... I'm sorry...
Wait! Where're our knights?!\nAnswer me!!
Heh, wouldn't tell you even if I knew it...\nIf you really wanna know... Ask Inzanio...\nUggh...
